messages:
sam_fin: FYI — ACME Corp invoice INV-9923 failed payment. Card declined twice with processor message "3d_secure_required". Customer tried updating card but 3DS won't complete on their side. They're on Dedicated plan and this is the renewal. Do we retry, hold, or ask for wire?

maya: Ugh. Do we have the last4 and processor error code?

sam_fin: Last4 4242. Processor code: 3ds_challenge_required. Attempts at 2025-06-18 12:11 UTC and 12:37 UTC. billing-bot shows 2 attempts. Customer says the 3DS challenge doesn't render in their browser.

eli_ops: If the 3DS flow can't complete client-side, blind retries usually fail. Options: 1) send a secure payment link (Stripe Checkout) 2) accept ACH/wire 3) Sales outreach to collect a new card. My recommendation: send a secure link and give 48h before pausing access.

nora-sales: I'll contact the customer now. If they want to wire, we need to supply wire instructions + invoice PDF. Can billing put the invoice/account on a temporary hold for 48h so we don't automatically suspend them?

sam_fin: Yes — we can place INV-9923 on hold for 48h and disable automated retries for this invoice. I'll pause the retry schedule and attach the wire template.

billing-bot: Automated action: Payment retry schedule paused for INV-9923. Next scheduled retry canceled. (action id: b-2025-778)

maya: Also consider offering ACH micro-deposit verification as an alternative — sometimes customer's AP prefers that.

sam_fin: Good call. If they pick ACH, send these steps:
```
1) Send secure bank-add link to customer.
2) We will deposit two micro-amounts within 1-2 business days.
3) Customer confirms amounts and we clear the invoice.
```

eli_ops: I'll attach the invoice PDF to the outreach and add the customer's AP contact to CC. I can also include a prefilled wire template: 
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: FirstExample Bank
Routing: 111000025
Account: 123456789
Reference: INV-9923 / ACME Corp
```

nora-sales: Thanks. Will update when I hear back. @sam_fin can you add the wire instructions to Zendesk ticket #4521 so the CS rep has it?

sam_fin: Done — Zendesk #4521 updated with wire instructions + invoice PDF. Also disabled retries and set hold expiration to 48h from now. Ping me if you want us to trigger a manual retry.

nora-sales: noted :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Note: If no response by 48h the account will be suspended per billing policy. Notification scheduled at hold expiry. (policy ref: billing-v2-2024)
